[energy_efficiency: Energy efficiency; EU objective ccm] Include: Heat pumps; high-efficiency motors, drives, lighting (LED) and HVAC; building and industrial energy-management systems and controls; efficiency retrofits and energy-service (ESCO) contracts; district heating and cooling from renewable or waste heat. Exclude: Efficiency upgrades of fossil-fuel generation, extraction or processing assets (transition row); fossil-fuel boilers and furnaces, even high-efficiency ones; product improvements without a disclosed energy-saving basis; nuclear (flagged in the transition row). [clean_transport: Clean transport; EU objective ccm] Include: Battery-electric and fuel-cell vehicles and their components (batteries, e-drives); electrified rail, metro and tram and their rolling stock; charging and hydrogen-refuelling infrastructure; e-bikes, cycling and public-transport infrastructure; zero-direct-emission vessels and aircraft. Exclude: Internal-combustion vehicles including plug-in and mild hybrids (transition row); LNG or CNG vehicles and vessels (transition row); efficiency gains on fossil-fuelled fleets (transition row); infrastructure dedicated to transporting fossil fuels; nuclear (flagged in the transition row). [green_buildings: Green buildings; EU objective ccm] Include: New buildings with primary energy demand at least 10% below the nearly-zero-energy standard or certified at top tiers (LEED Platinum or Gold, BREEAM Excellent or Outstanding, DGNB Gold or Platinum, Energy Star 85 or more); major renovations cutting primary energy demand by at least 30%; buildings with an EPC class A. Exclude: Buildings whose only green attribute is a lower-tier certificate; buildings dedicated to extracting, storing or transporting fossil fuels; efficiency equipment sold on its own (energy_efficiency); nuclear (flagged in the transition row). [grids_storage: Grids and storage; EU objective ccm] Include: Transmission and distribution lines, substations and interconnectors on grids that meet a decarbonisation pathway or connect renewables; smart meters and grid digitalisation; battery, pumped-hydro, thermal and other energy storage. Exclude: Direct connections to fossil-fuel plants; fossil gas grids and storage (transition row only if converted for hydrogen or blending); nuclear (flagged in the transition row). [hydrogen: Hydrogen; EU objective ccm] Include: Electrolytic hydrogen from renewable electricity with lifecycle emissions below 3 tCO2e per tonne of hydrogen; electrolysers and fuel cells; hydrogen pipelines, storage and refuelling; green ammonia and e-fuels made from it. Exclude: Grey hydrogen from unabated fossil gas; blue hydrogen from fossil gas with CCS (transition row); hydrogen from nuclear electricity (flagged in the transition row). [ccus: Carbon capture, use and storage; EU objective ccm] Include: Direct air capture; bioenergy with carbon capture and storage; capture equipment, CO2 transport and permanent geological storage; CO2 use in long-lived products such as mineralised building materials. Exclude: CO2 for enhanced oil recovery; capture at fossil-fuel power plants or upstream oil and gas assets (transition row); trading in carbon credits or offsets without own capture; nuclear (flagged in the transition row). [low_carbon_materials: Low-carbon materials and products; EU objective ccm] Include: Steel, cement, aluminium, chemicals and plastics produced below the EU Taxonomy threshold or a disclosed science-based benchmark (for example hydrogen-DRI steel, low-clinker cement); bio-based materials from sustainable sources; components whose main purpose is a low-carbon technology (wind blades, battery materials) when not counted in another category. Exclude: Incremental reductions on conventional production without a stated benchmark; products marketed as low-carbon without a disclosed basis; materials for fossil-fuel extraction; nuclear (flagged in the transition row). [circular_economy: Circular economy; EU objective ce] Include: Material recovery and recycling; remanufacturing, refurbishment, repair and product-as-a-service models; sale of secondary raw materials; separate waste collection; anaerobic digestion and composting of bio-waste. Exclude: Waste incineration, including with energy recovery; landfill; downcycling sold as recycling without a disclosed recovery rate; nuclear (flagged in the transition row). [water_pollution: Water and pollution control; EU objective wtr;ppc] Include: Water supply and wastewater treatment that meet an efficiency or quality improvement; water reuse and renewable-powered desalination; leak reduction; air, soil and water pollution-control equipment; remediation of contaminated sites; nature-based flood and drought protection.
